title: Dental Oral Clinic Glass Sticker Translucent Opaque Dental Hospital Frosted Film
description:
Dental Oral Clinic Glass Sticker Translucent Opaque Dental Hospital Frosted Film
All orders will be shipped within 2 days after placing the order, and the fastest will be shipped within 1 day. It will take about 7-10 days for the package to reach its destination.

Product name: vacuum stickers
Features: High-definition printing, Waterproof and sunscreen, tear off without glue, double sided pattern
Function: beautify and enrich the store atmosphere, while also preventing collisions
Applicable: smooth glass/mirror/ceramic tile

All sizes are for one complete sheet of stickers (the goods received are one complete sheet of stickers)

Instructions:
1. Prepare a spray bottle, towel, and plastic scraper
2. After cleaning the glass, spray water on it. The more you spray, the better.
3.Tear off the protective backing behind the film and spray water on the film
4. Paste it on the glass that was sprayed with water just now
5. Wrap the scraper in a towel and scrape away the air bubbles and moisture between the glass and sticker
6. Finally, dry it with a towel and you are done.

#glasssticker #window decoration #window sticker #glass door sticker #static sticker #shop layout #coffee shop decoration #milk tea shop decoration
source_text:
Dental Oral Clinic Glass Sticker Translucent Opaque Dental Hospital Frosted Film Dental Oral Clinic Glass Sticker Translucent Opaque Dental Hospital Frosted Film
All orders will be shipped within 2 days after placing the order, and the fastest will be shipped within 1 day. It will take about 7-10 days for the package to reach its destination.

Product name: vacuum stickers
Features: High-definition printing, Waterproof and sunscreen, tear off without glue, double sided pattern
Function: beautify and enrich the store atmosphere, while also preventing collisions
Applicable: smooth glass/mirror/ceramic tile

All sizes are for one complete sheet of stickers (the goods received are one complete sheet of stickers)

Instructions:
1. Prepare a spray bottle, towel, and plastic scraper
2. After cleaning the glass, spray water on it. The more you spray, the better.
3.Tear off the protective backing behind the film and spray water on the film
4. Paste it on the glass that was sprayed with water just now
5. Wrap the scraper in a towel and scrape away the air bubbles and moisture between the glass and sticker
6. Finally, dry it with a towel and you are done.
